name: custtoolset_pillar10_extractor
description: Extracts real-time proactive monitoring alerts, identifying recent threshold breaches (like script limits or severe latency) and stalled integration queues.

analysisType.description: The specific real-time alert dataset to extract. Use 'threshold_breaches' for immediate script latency/errors or 'stalled_integrations' for failing middleware queues.

returns.description: A JSON payload containing time-stamped incident data for real-time AI triage.
